scope: Public IVYUN chat Stop/next-question state and dedicated SSH reverse tunnel recovery

fixes.behavior: An already-aborted fresh generation finishes locally before POST. An already-aborted resumed generation sends cancellation for its existing ID and preserves an unconfirmed cancellation on failure.
Record completion of the model stream before rendering/chart postprocessing so a later Stop does not leave a completed generation pending.

After 30 seconds without SSH payload, require three unanswered application probes on the same dedicated listener/socket with unchanged received-byte count. Release only that pinned process. A working SSH response aborts recovery.

regression.preFixReproduction: Stop during generation-ID persistence produced status reconnecting instead of aborted.
specificCases: Stop during initial save then send next question
Already-aborted resumed generation, reachable and unreachable cancellation
Disconnect/replay keeps one inference and one tool action

isolatedFaultTests.environment: Linux transient systemd services with PrivateNetwork=yes, loopback-only SSH server/client and synthetic HTTP endpoint

cases.name: SSH application stalled while TCP still acknowledged
SSH transport packets lost on isolated loopback
Local gateway unavailable but SSH responding
Deployed checker running with production service capabilities and protection settings

isolatedFaultTests.timingScope: Measured isolated checker and replacement SSH client. Production also includes the timer phase, Windows reconnect backoff and network availability.
isolatedFaultTests.testHarnessCorrection: The first gateway-only negative check waited for 30 seconds of SSH inactivity, which was interrupted by normal SSH keepalives. A follow-up test forced checker eligibility inside the isolated process and verified that an SSH response to the failed application probe preserves the listener.

publicVerification.faultScope: Only the synthetic browser reader was disconnected and its context set offline. Production SSH was not interrupted for this test.

causality: The incident logs correlated a lost public stream with a stalled SSH listener. The additional Stop-during-save race was independently reproduced, without claiming it caused that specific earlier incident.
